A11.name: 夜幕處刑者
A11.design: a fitted sleeveless smoke-black leather jerkin, a cropped diagonal dark-plum shoulder cloak with a silver crescent brooch and fine Greek-key embroidery, three short pointed leather waist panels over full charcoal trousers, narrow crossed black belts, slender silver-edged wrist guards and supple strapped boots. Two broad-leaf silver short daggers, black wrapped grips and tiny violet shadow threads within the engraved blade grooves. A compact executioner silhouette with sharp layered waist panels and an exposed lightweight shoulder, no long cloak

A111.name: 冥夜裁決者
A111.design: a refined charcoal leather coat ending at upper hip with narrow split panels, a high short standing collar, two small asymmetrical deep-violet shoulder capelets, an elegant silver moon-phase chain across the collar, a slender crescent buckle belt, fitted charcoal trousers, soft tall boots and thin silver-line bracers. Exactly two narrow crescent-edged short daggers etched with moon-phase grooves and a restrained cold violet sheen. A lean moonlit judge assassin; distinct twin capelet silhouette and precise silver detailing, no heavy shoulder plate or long robe

A112.name: 終焉斷刃
A112.design: an asymmetrical charcoal-black fitted leather waistcoat over dark fitted sleeves, a single sharply angular cropped near-black purple half-cloak with a small broken-circle silver brooch, two diagonal silver-thread straps forming a fractured-line pattern on the chest, a slim plain black belt and three triangular short leather hip panels, full fitted black trousers and flexible ankle-high boots, narrow geometric wrist guards. Exactly two compact angular silver short daggers with intact clipped points and fine violet fracture-line engravings contained inside the blades. A clean angular final-blade assassin silhouette, no floating blade pieces and no oversized weapon
